## OpenUtau Mobile 1.1.0

> **Vibe-coded with AI.** The additions in this app (Custom resamplers, Auto pitch, Harmony generator, piano roll video export and the features below) were written by [Claude](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Anthropic's AI, Claude Sonnet 5.5), directed by sparky-commits1637. The code has not been hand-reviewed, so please report problems.

### What's new in 1.1.0
- **Resampler catalog.** Options → **Resamplers** has a **Catalog** tab for downloading ready-made resamplers, and a **My own** tab for the ones you added yourself. Every catalog is digitally signed and every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is installed. The catalog is empty for now.
- **Test resampler.** In the track's renderer settings there is now a **Test resampler** button. It runs the resampler once and shows the exit code and the program's output, so you can see why one fails.
- **Check voicebank.** The voicebank details page has a **Check voicebank** button that explains problems in plain language (missing files, broken oto lines, wrong sample rate, name case problems that break on Android) and lists unused files you can delete.
- **Force re-render.** The editor's ⋮ menu has **Force re-render**, which clears the render cache when a preview sounds out of date.
- **Update check.** The app looks for a newer release a few seconds after starting and shows its notes once per version.

### Updating
- Signed with the same key as the previous releases, so it installs over them and keeps your data.
- The package name is unchanged, so it still installs separately from the official OpenUtau Mobile. Android **ARM64** only.
